items.idea: The QQ penguin becomes a menacing Chinese overlord: red scarf, angry brows, laser beams from its eyes, and the Chinese flag's stars burning behind it.
items.fusion: The mascot is turned into the flag's villain. Its scarf takes the flag red, its beak and the stars share the flag yellow, and the stars and flames are built into the background around its head. The laser beams cross the whole frame and tie the eyes to the corners.
layers: red-black flame pattern wallpaper
yellow star clusters left and right
orange ember particles
green laser beams from the eyes to the bottom corners
big penguin cut-out with a rim light
glowing green eyes
red scarf and tongue
yellow edge glow at the bottom
items.edges: Very dense. Flame shapes fill every corner, stars sit on both sides, embers are scattered across the frame and the lasers run to the bottom edges. The only calm area is the penguin's black head and white belly, which gives the busy background a clear focal point.
items.background: A mirrored flame-ornament wallpaper in saturated red and black, with the Chinese flag's yellow stars as a repeating motif, so the national colours become the fire.
items.lettering: none
items.phoneRead: An angry penguin with laser eyes in flag colours, the sinister Chinese company behind a familiar logo.
items.recipe: Cut out the QQ penguin logo from a clean PNG. Edit the eyebrows and eye glow in Photoshop. Build the background from a mirrored tribal-flame or ornament pattern in red and black. Add yellow stars from the flag, one large and four small on each side. Draw two green-white laser lines with a glow from the eyes to the corners, and add real ember or spark footage on Screen. Grade with heavy contrast and saturation, and add a thin yellow rim light around the penguin.
items.title: The Secret Chinese Company That Owns Everything

items.idea: The Coca-Cola logo is printed on a giant glass of fizzing cola, so the whole drink is the brand and the headline implies something dark in it.
items.fusion: The logo is not on top of a glass but is the label printed on the side of the glass itself, which has foam spilling over the rim. The title ribbon in a red-white swoosh runs across the top and ends where the glass begins, so the headline reads 'The DARK TRUTH of' and finishes with the logo.
layers: flat Coke-red background with faint bottle and glass outlines
white wave swooshes across the frame
Christmas trucks and bottle crates riding on the waves
dark silhouette of a bottle and glass behind the title
giant glass of dark cola with foam and ice, logo over it
black ribbon title plate with white serif text
items.edges: Red fills every edge, and the white waves carry trucks left and right and crates of bottles at the lower left and right. The glass fills the middle from the bottom to the title bar. The faint outlines add texture in the red.
items.background: The brand's own world: Coke red, the white wave from the label, trucks and bottle crates repeated as a pattern. It is pure brand and all one colour family.
items.lettering: A white serif in a black ribbon with a thin red swoosh through it. 'The' and 'of' are small italics and 'DARK TRUTH' is in large bold capitals. It is wide, across the top, with a shadow and a bevel. The black bar is the only dark note, which sells the 'dark' idea.
items.phoneRead: Something dark about Coca-Cola, shown as a huge glass of cola with the logo.
items.recipe: Take a photo of a glass of cola with foam and crop it to a big shape. Mask or warp the white Coca-Cola script onto it with a multiply or overlay blend so it follows the glass. Fill the background with red, add white wave shapes, and place cut-outs of the Coke truck and six-pack crates on them. Add faded bottle silhouettes at low opacity. Build the black title ribbon with a white serif and a red curve through it.
items.title: The Disturbing History of Coca-Cola

items.idea: The Netflix N stands untouched in the middle of a wall of fire, so the empire is burning.
items.fusion: The flames burn right up to and behind the N, and the N's red glows with the same orange-yellow light, so the logo seems to be in the fire, not pasted over it. The show posters in the dark upper background are the 'empire' being consumed.
layers: dark background of Netflix show posters
fire sheet across the lower two thirds
fire on both sides, taller than the N's edges
big red 3D N logo with a yellow rim glow
embers and sparks in front
items.edges: Fire runs to the bottom, left and right edges in dense orange and yellow tongues, and the posters fill the dark top corners. The N takes the centre column from top to bottom. There is no empty area.
items.background: Faded rows of Netflix poster thumbnails, darkened, which show the content library going up in flames.
items.lettering: None. The burning logo carries the idea, and the title is left to the video title.
items.phoneRead: Netflix is on fire and collapsing, read in one glance from a red N in flames.
items.recipe: Cut out the red N logo and add a thin yellow-orange outer glow. Darken a grid of Netflix posters for the top. Overlay stock fire footage on screen or add blend mode, with one on each side and a bigger one at the bottom. Put a few small embers over the N, and grade everything warm orange with a dark vignette.
items.title: Why Netflix is Collapsing: The Truth About Netflix's Empire

items.idea: A hooded homeless kid sits in front of a crumbling wall where the plaster is peeling away to reveal the Louis Vuitton monogram, so poverty and luxury are the same wall.
items.fusion: The wall is split in two: the lower part is torn brick (street) and the upper part is LV monogram leather (luxury), with a ragged plaster edge as the seam. The boy sits on that seam and his hood rises into the monogram. The yellow LV wordmark runs across his knees, tying the brand to him.
layers: brick wall texture at the bottom
LV monogram leather pattern at the top with a torn, peeling edge
boy cut-out, hoodie and jeans, centre
giant yellow LOUIS VUITTON wordmark across the bottom, partly behind his hands
orange/gold grade with grain and vignette
items.edges: The monogram pattern fills the whole top, the brick fills the sides and bottom, and the boy's body runs from the top-centre to the bottom. The wordmark spans the full width at the bottom. There is no empty space.
items.background: The brand's own monogram pattern in gold on dark leather, ripped off to show red brick underneath. The background tells the whole story: a luxury brand built on a street.
items.lettering: Wide thin sans-serif capitals in saturated yellow, spanning the full width at the bottom. No outline or box. The boy's hands and knees overlap the letters, which keeps the text in the picture.
items.phoneRead: A street kid in front of the Louis Vuitton pattern: poor kid, luxury brand.
items.recipe: Tile the LV monogram into a wallpaper and warp it onto a leather texture. Mask the lower half with a torn-paper edge and put a brick photo underneath. Cut out a sitting hooded figure and put him in the centre, letting the hood overlap the pattern. Type the wordmark in yellow in a wide geometric sans and put it behind the hands. Grade everything orange-gold, add grain, and darken the corners.
items.title: The Homeless Teen Who Created Louis Vuitton

items.idea: A hand picks the padlock open right under the WhatsApp bubble, so the app that promises privacy is being broken into.
items.fusion: The lock and hand sit at the foot of the giant logo bubble, so the hand reaches toward the app's tail. The red 'Betrayal' box touches the green 'WhatsApp' box and stacks into one headline block that points to the logo. The red notification badge '1' on the bubble reads as an incoming message and also as a warning.
layers: near-black background filled with columns of white binary and digits
dark vignette and fog behind the subject
glowing white padlock with a pale hand reaching in from the right
giant 3D WhatsApp bubble with a white rim and drop shadow, cropped on the right
red notification badge '1'
green and red label boxes stacked top left
gold MM channel badge bottom left
items.edges: Digits and binary run to every edge in varying sizes and opacities, big and bright at the top and right, small and dim in the lower middle. The only breathing room is the dark gap between the lock and the headline boxes. The bubble nearly touches the right and bottom edges.
items.background: A hacker-matrix wall of 0s, 1s and numbers on black. It sets the surveillance and data theme, and the green logo and white lock stand out hard against it.
items.lettering: A heavy white bold sans-serif, 'The WhatsApp' in a bright green rectangle and 'Betrayal' in a deep red rectangle below it. Large, top left, filling about 60% of the width. The boxes are flat and hard-edged, with a slight shadow, and the red box overlaps the green one's edge. The colours echo the logo (green) and a warning (red).
items.phoneRead: WhatsApp has been compromised or betrayed, since a hand is picking a lock beside the logo.
items.recipe: Cut out the WhatsApp icon as a PNG and add a thick white outline and a heavy drop shadow. Cut out a stock photo of a hand pinching a padlock and desaturate it to high-contrast black and white, with a white outer glow on the lock. Build the background from a free binary-code or matrix texture on black, scaled up and blurred in places, with a vignette. Draw two flat rectangles in the logo green and a warning red, set the text in a Montserrat/Gotham-style extra bold, and offset the boxes so they overlap. Add the red '1' badge as a separate circle.
items.title: How WhatsApp Makes Money: The INSANE Story of WhatsApp

items.idea: A smug 1920s Ponzi sits up to his neck in cash with a pyramid scheme drawn behind him, and a strip of tape across his eyes calls him THE RICH IDIOT.
items.fusion: He emerges from the money pile as if he were bathing in it. The brush-stroke label covers his eyes and overlaps his hat, so the insult is stuck onto his face. A banknote is tucked in the hatband, which ties him to the money.
layers: dark grainy black background
two white pyramid diagrams of stick figures, one on each side
tall stacks of $100 bills spread across the bottom
cut-out Ponzi in a boater hat and purple suit, colourised
a banknote in the hat band
white brush-stroke strip across the eyes with red italic text
items.edges: Cash fills the whole bottom third from left to right. The pyramids fill the upper left and right. The dark centre around the head is the only open area and keeps the face clear.
items.background: Dark grainy black with outline pyramids. They carry the scam theme and are symmetrical, so the eye is pulled to the face in the middle.
items.lettering: 'the rich idiot' in bold red italic lowercase sans serif, on a white torn brush-stroke banner that slants across the eyes. It is mid-frame, with the white banner giving the highest contrast against the dark background.
items.phoneRead: A smug old-time man is buried in money, and the label calls him a rich idiot. It reads as a scammer who got rich.
items.recipe: Cut out a vintage Ponzi portrait and colourise it, with a saturated purple suit and a warm skin tone. Layer many photos of cash stacks, rotated and overlapped, across the bottom. Draw the stick-figure pyramids as simple white line graphics and duplicate them symmetrically. Paste a single bill into the hatband. Create the label with a white paint-stroke brush or mask and place red italic text over it. Add a grain texture over the dark background.
items.title: Ponzi: The Financial Idiot Who Scammed the World

items.idea: A fat-cheeked smiling man holds two fanned stacks of hundred-dollar bills like a winning hand, flanked by two famous faces who look like his trophies, so 'robbed a country' reads as a cash-rich party.
items.fusion: The man's hands and cash sit in the foreground and overlap the bottom of both celebrity cut-outs, so the money physically ties the three people together instead of sitting next to them. The two flankers are cropped large and tucked behind his shoulders, so they act as his entourage.
layers: flat blue sky and green grass backdrop
left celebrity cut-out, large, cropped at the frame edge
right celebrity cut-out, large, cropped at the frame edge
central man with black tux and bow tie, overlapping both
two fanned bill stacks at the bottom, pointing inward
white cut-out outline and warm glow grade over the faces
items.edges: Three faces fill the full height and width: the left and right heads are clipped by the frame edges, and the shoulders and suit run off the bottom. The bills cover the lower centre. The only breathing room is the strip of sky and grass between the heads.
items.background: A simple saturated sky-over-lawn stock image in blue and green, a cheerful 'sunny day' that clashes with the crime story and makes the skin tones and green dollar bills stand out.
items.lettering: none
items.phoneRead: A smiling rich man with cash and two celebrities: this guy is wealthy and connected to famous people.
items.recipe: Cut out three clean portraits with a thin white edge. Place the man centre and the two celebrities scaled up behind him, bleeding off the edges. Cut out two hands holding bill fans (or build each fan from a bill photo copied and fanned) and put them at the bottom, angled inward. Use a stock sky/grass photo as background. Boost saturation and warmth on the faces, add a slight sharpening and a soft shadow behind each cut-out.
items.title: The Man Who Robbed An Entire Country

items.idea: A hand grips a white Nike Air Force 1 like a bloody trophy, so the shoe reads as a thing built from nothing and paid for in pain, resting on a pile of cash.
items.fusion: The blood is on the product itself: spatter dots across the midsole, a thick pool dripping off the heel, and the same red running down the hand holding it. The hand, the shoe, the blood and the money all overlap in one cluster, so the story is in the object rather than beside it.
layers: blue blueprint grid with handwritten sketches
giant pale cyan NIKE wordmark, partly hidden
white sneaker with orange swoosh, large and angled
hand cut-out gripping the shoe's side
blood spatter, pool and drips over shoe and hand
pile of $100 bills across the bottom edge
items.edges: The money fills the entire bottom edge and climbs the left and right corners. The blueprint doodles cover the top and sides, and the shoe nearly touches the top and left. Only the dark blue patches between the wordmark letters give any space.
items.background: A saturated blue technical blueprint with grid lines and scribbled notes and sketches, which speaks to the idea of a kid designing something from scratch. The ghosted NIKE letters in lighter cyan sit behind the shoe to name the brand.
items.lettering: None in the image; the only lettering is the cropped, translucent cyan NIKE wordmark used as a background texture and partly covered by the shoe.
items.phoneRead: A bloodied Nike shoe held up above a heap of cash: Nike's riches came out of a violent struggle.
items.recipe: Cut out an Air Force 1 from a product photo with an orange swoosh recolour, and cut out a hand holding it from a stock photo. Add real blood splatter and drip PNGs on a Multiply or Normal layer over the midsole, heel and hand. Pile real dollar-bill photos or cut-outs along the bottom, overlapping and rotated. Build the blueprint from a blue grid texture with handwriting overlays. Set the Nike wordmark in pale cyan at about 40% opacity behind the shoe. Finish with a soft glow on the shoe and a saturation boost.
items.title: How A Kid With $0 Created Nike

items.idea: Uber's logo is locked in handcuffs while a red arrow keeps climbing behind it, so growth and crime are one story.
items.fusion: The handcuffs clamp onto the corner of the Uber app tile, and the red growth arrow shoots out from behind the same tile. The cars drive toward the tile along a road curve, so the cuffs, arrow and cars all meet at the logo.
layers: blue-teal city map and skyline background, blurred and tinted
curved road swoosh
white and black car illustrations on the road
big red arrow rising up and right behind the tile
black Uber app tile with a white rim and shadow
metal handcuffs overlapping the tile's top left corner
red and black label boxes top left
MM badge bottom left
items.edges: The map texture and skyline fill the whole frame with fine lines and lights. The tile takes the right half, the cars the lower left, the labels the upper left, and the arrow bursts into the top right corner. The gap between the headline and the cars is the only quiet area.
items.background: A teal-blue street map with glowing roads and city buildings, which suits ride-hailing, and it is dark enough to let the black tile and white text stand out.
items.lettering: A bold white condensed sans-serif. 'The Illegal Rise' sits in a red box and 'of Uber' in a black box with a larger 'Uber', stacked at upper left. The red echoes the arrow and the black matches the tile. Large and legible, with 'Uber' the biggest word.
items.phoneRead: Uber grew by breaking the law, because the logo is handcuffed and the arrow points up.
items.recipe: Cut out the Uber tile and the handcuffs, and paste the cuffs on top so one cuff ring overlaps the tile edge, with a contact shadow. Add a red 3D arrow behind the tile. Use a city map screenshot or stock cityscape, tint it teal and blur it. Place two stock car cut-outs, one white and one black, along a curved road swoosh. Add the red and black text boxes with white type, and the MM badge.
items.title: The Uber Story: Fraud, Betrayal, Death & Cars

items.idea: The Burger King mascot holds a burger stuffed with cash instead of beef, so the brand's secret is that money is the real product.
items.fusion: The money sits inside the bun in the king's hands, so burger and cash are one object. Everything around him is brand: the crown has the logo, and the red, yellow and blue stripes are the logo's own colours.
layers: blue top and bottom bands with a food-pattern texture
yellow and red horizontal stripes
two giant Burger King logos cropped at the sides
cyan glow behind the head
king mascot cut-out with fur collar
crown with a small logo
hands gripping the bun
stacks of green dollar bills inside the bun
items.edges: Dense. Giant logos run off both sides, the stripes cross the full width, the king's head touches the top and his fur and arms fill the bottom. The only quiet area is the stripe between the logos behind his face.
items.background: Brand wallpaper: the stripes and oversized logos in the exact red, yellow and blue palette, with a subtle pattern in the blue bands so the brand surrounds the mascot.
items.lettering: none apart from the Burger King logos used as graphics. The title is not repeated as text. The logo type is huge, red with a blue and yellow ring, and cropped by the frame.
items.phoneRead: The Burger King mascot biting into a burger full of cash. Brand plus money means a story about how the company really makes money.
items.recipe: Cut out the King mascot with his hands in front. Mask a pile of cash photos or a stack of bills into the bun, using layer order to put the top bun over them. Place the Burger King logo twice, large and cropped, over horizontal red and yellow bands. Add a blue pattern at the top and bottom edges. Add a cyan glow behind the head. Push saturation and contrast and add a slight chromatic aberration for a punchy look.
items.title: The Untold TRUTH of Burger King

items.idea: The Pepsi logo is printed on a huge glass of cola that fills the frame, with the brand's own trucks and bottles driving around it. The glass is the brand, and 'dark truth' tells you it is hiding something.
items.fusion: The logo is placed on the front of the glass so it reads as printed on it. The white wave stripes run through the picture and carry the trucks and crates of bottles along their paths. The cola's dark bubbling liquid is the 'dark' of the title.
layers: Blue background with water droplets and faint soda bottles
White wave stripes sweeping across
Pepsi trucks and rows of bottle crates riding the waves
Huge glass of cola with foam on top
Pepsi globe and white wordmark on the glass
Black banner with title text across the top
items.edges: The waves reach both edges. Bottle crates run along the bottom, trucks sit at the sides, and the glass fills the centre. Droplets and ghosted bottles cover the blue. The only empty space is the white wave bands.
items.background: Pepsi-blue made of droplets and half-hidden competitor bottles. It shows the product's world, and the wave pattern echoes the logo's own curve.
items.lettering: 'The DARK TRUTH of' is in a white serif on a black banner, with 'DARK TRUTH' in heavy bold caps and 'The' and 'of' small and italic. It sits across the top and is cut by a white and blue swoosh that ties it to the brand shapes. The Pepsi wordmark in the glass completes the sentence.
items.phoneRead: A big Pepsi cola glass under 'The Dark Truth of' says this is an exposé of Pepsi.
items.recipe: Make a blue background with a droplet texture overlay. Draw white swooshes with the pen tool, and place truck and bottle-crate cut-outs along them, warped to follow the curves. Cut out a glass of cola with foam, darken it and add an orange rim light. Put the official Pepsi logo and wordmark on top. Add a black rectangle at the top with a serif font and white text, and let a swoosh overlap it.
items.title: Why Pepsi Went Bankrupt

items.idea: Coco Chanel sits on a throne in front of a ruined, burning city with a swastika armband on her sleeve, so the glamour is tied to the occupation.
items.fusion: The red armband is on the white sleeve, right under her arm, so the Nazi link is part of the outfit. The chair frame and pink glow tie her to the ruin behind. Chanel products stand on the pedestals, which makes the brand part of the same scene.
layers: smoky pink sky over war-damaged buildings with fire
ruined city photo on both sides
two white pedestals with a Chanel handbag and a perfume bottle
ornate red-gold throne with magenta cushions
woman in a grey suit, white shirt and tie, centred
red armband with a swastika on her sleeve
pink glow and chromatic grade
items.edges: The throne fills the lower half and the cushions run to the bottom corners. The ruins and smoke fill the upper corners, and the pedestals frame her on both sides. Only the centre top breathes, where the head meets the pink haze.
items.background: A ruined, burning street scene in magenta and red. It shows war and destruction against the luxury throne, and the single pink colour binds it all together.
items.lettering: None. The armband is the one loud detail.
items.phoneRead: A stern woman on a throne with a Nazi armband in front of ruins, which reads as a dark secret.
items.recipe: Cut out a woman in a suit with a short hair style. Add an ornate throne photo behind her. Put the armband on the sleeve with a warp. Layer a bombed-city photo, fire and smoke overlays behind. Cut out a Chanel bag and a perfume bottle and set them on pedestals. Grade everything in magenta, add glow and chromatic fringe.
items.title: The Disturbing Story of Coco Chanel

items.idea: A face split down the middle: Hershey on one half, Willy Wonka on the other, so the real man is merged with the fictional one.
items.fusion: One face is built from two halves joined at a white centre seam. The hat spans both halves. Each side's backdrop matches its half: the Hershey sign and brick on the left, the Chocolate Factory sign with smokestacks on the right.
layers: blue sky on the left and warm orange sunset on the right
Hershey building and sign on the left, chocolate factory with chimneys on the right
split portrait of Milton Hershey and Willy Wonka
large red top hat across both halves
gold bow tie and collar at the bottom
white vertical divider line
sparkles and glints on the right sign
items.edges: Signs and buildings fill both sides, the hat reaches the top, and the shoulders run to the bottom. The face is the focus, and the sky at the top corners is the only breathing space.
items.background: A split background: cool blue sky and brick on the left for the real company, a warm gold glow and steampunk factory on the right for the fantasy.
items.lettering: The text is part of the scene: the Hershey sign in bold dark serif capitals and the Chocolate Factory sign in an ornate gold script. There is no added title.
items.phoneRead: Two faces make one man, so the real Hershey equals Willy Wonka.
items.recipe: Cut out portraits of Milton Hershey and Gene Wilder's Wonka, then crop each to half a face and align the eyes, nose and chin. Put a red top hat over both. Add a white line at the seam. Place a Hershey sign photo on the left and a Wonka factory image on the right. Grade the left cool and the right warm, then add sparkle overlays.
items.title: Hershey: The Real Life Willy Wonka

items.idea: A hooded Guy Fawkes mask figure weighs two Eiffel Towers like a seller offering them for a price.
items.fusion: The figure's open palms hold the two miniature towers. A red price tag with a question mark hangs from each tower, and a banknote comes out of the lower hand. The shrug pose, the towers and the tags form one scam gesture.
layers: blue sky and Paris skyline at sunset
faint code text overlay across the sky
hooded figure with an Anonymous mask, centred and large
two tower models in raised open hands
red question-mark price tags hanging on strings
banknote in the lower right foreground
glow streaks and digital interface lines
items.edges: Code lines fill the left and right edges, hands come in from both sides, the hood reaches the top and the sleeves and torso reach the bottom. The face is the only calm area.
items.background: A cyan to orange sky over Paris with lines of code printed over it. The code gives the con-artist or hacker feel, and the sunset sky gives it the Paris setting.
items.lettering: None. The red tags with white question marks act as the text, in a bold, rounded sans style.
items.phoneRead: A masked scammer is selling two Eiffel Towers, so it reads as a con.
items.recipe: Cut out a person in a hoodie with arms out in a shrug, and mask a Guy Fawkes face onto the head. Cut out two Eiffel Tower souvenirs and set each on a palm. Draw the red price tags with white question marks and add string. Cut out a banknote and place it in the lower right. Build the background from a Paris sunset photo plus a screenshot of code at low opacity. Add rim light and a teal-orange grade.
items.title: The Scammer Who Sold The Eiffel Tower (Twice)

items.idea: The Red Bull logo is shown without the drink and followed by a giant red question mark, asking what the company actually is.
items.fusion: The bull and the question mark share the same red, white outline and black offset shadow, so they look like one logo asking itself. The question mark takes the place where the can would be.
layers: blue and white diagonal split background with water droplets
yellow and orange sun disc
red bull with white outline and dark offset shadow
big red question mark with the same shadow on the right
items.edges: The bull fills the left half and the question mark fills the right half. The diagonal colour blocks go to every edge. Droplets add texture in the corners. The frame is sparse, with some empty background between the two shapes.
items.background: The brand's own blue, silver and yellow-red palette, cut into diagonal blocks and sprinkled with condensation droplets to suggest a cold can.
items.lettering: none. The question mark is the only text and is drawn as a graphic.
items.phoneRead: The Red Bull bull and a big question mark: what is Red Bull really?
items.recipe: Place the official bull logo over the yellow circle with a white stroke and a dark offset shadow. Build the background from two diagonal blue and white blocks and overlay a real water-droplet texture. Add a bold red question mark in the same style. To add more energy, put a can silhouette or a racing/sports cut-out behind the question mark.
items.title: Why Red Bull Isn't A Drink Company

items.idea: A screaming man in glasses stands in front of Gucci's villa, framed like a stage, so the fashion house reads as a scandal and a horror story.
items.fusion: The red and green of Gucci's stripe run through the whole scene. The stripe crosses the building, the curtains are Gucci green, the columns and floor glow red, and the man's face is lit in the same colours, so a real scandal feels like it is happening inside the brand.
layers: villa photo in green foliage
Gucci red-and-green stripe across the middle
green velvet curtains at the top corners
two red Ionic columns on the sides
product on each column, a perfume bottle and a handbag
screaming man cut-out in the centre
red glow and haze at the bottom
yellow serif GUCCI lettering
items.edges: Quite dense. Curtains fill the top corners, columns anchor the sides and the villa and foliage fill the middle. The man's body and the word GUCCI fill the bottom. The sky above the villa and the dark gaps beside the head are the only calm areas.
items.background: The brand's world: the Gucci family villa tinted red-green, with the signature stripe and a theatre curtain, so the scene looks like a stage set about to blow up.
items.lettering: GUCCI in a wide-spaced yellow-gold serif, all caps, no box and no outline. It sits across the bottom, behind the man's shoulders so his suit overlaps the letters, and is the same width as the whole frame.
items.phoneRead: A man screaming in front of a Gucci mansion with a yellow GUCCI word, which means family drama and a Gucci scandal.
items.recipe: Cut out a dramatic screaming-face shot, in this case a stylised or AI-edited portrait. Use a villa photo behind him and tint it with a gradient map in red and green. Draw the red and green stripe across the frame. Place green satin curtains at the top corners. Cut out the two columns, tint them red, and put a Gucci perfume and a Gucci bag on top. Type GUCCI in a gold serif such as Trajan or Cinzel with a wide tracking, and place the man's shoulders in front of it. Finish with red glow at the bottom and heavy contrast.
items.title: The F**ked Up History Of Gucci

items.idea: A scruffy, determined boy holds a giant wrench in front of a vintage Honda Civic and the Honda logo, so the child is visually the founder behind the car.
items.fusion: The boy is the largest element on the right, and the wrench sticks out of his shoulder into the car's grille. The car sits behind him on the left under the glowing logo, so the child, the tool and the product are one diagonal chain.
layers: blurred orange workshop/street background
vintage Civic cut-out in the middle left
glowing Honda logo above the car
blurred wheel in the bottom-left foreground
boy cut-out on the right with a rim light
wrench overlapping the car and the boy
strong HDR grade, outlines and glow
items.edges: The boy's head and shoulders touch the top and right edges, the car runs off the left edge, and the wheel fills the bottom-left corner. Warm bokeh fills the gaps, and only the area above the car around the logo is open.
items.background: A warm orange blurry garage and street scene that suggests a workshop. It keeps the whole image in one hot colour family against the cool teal of the car and the boy's shirt.
items.lettering: The only text is the Honda logo and wordmark in white with a glow, used as part of the picture. There is no separate headline.
items.phoneRead: A poor kid with a wrench next to a Honda car and logo: this child built Honda.
items.recipe: Cut out a child portrait and put it on the right, scaled up to near the top. Add a vintage Civic cut-out in the centre left. Float the Honda logo with an outer glow above the car. Cut out a wrench and angle it from the boy's chest to the car. Put a blurred tyre in the foreground. Use a warm blurred garage photo as background, apply a high-contrast HDR/clarity grade with teal and orange, and add a thin bright rim light to all the cut-outs.
items.title: The Poor Boy Who Created Honda

items.idea: A glitched marble Medusa head with glowing red eyes floats over a red-and-black version of the Versace mansion, so luxury looks cursed and murderous.
items.fusion: The Versace Medusa is the centrepiece, and its marble surface is covered by the same glitch and red scribbles as the mansion. A red and black treatment unites the statue and house into one blood-soaked scene, with no division between them.
layers: black-and-white mansion courtyard with red overlay
mosaic floor with red circles in the foreground
Medusa bust cut-out, centre
glitch and scribble texture over the face
red glowing eyes
dark vignette
items.edges: The mansion's arches, balconies and tiled floor occupy the left, right and lower areas. The Medusa fills the middle from top to bottom, and the darkness in the corners keeps it from feeling cluttered.
items.background: The real Versace mansion courtyard in high-contrast black and white, flooded with red. This connects the story's location to the murder.
items.lettering: None; the Medusa head acts as the logo.
items.phoneRead: A creepy Medusa head over a red mansion: Versace, wealth and a violent death.
items.recipe: Take a photo of the mansion courtyard and convert it to black and white with a red overlay or gradient map. Cut out a Medusa head or bust, add heavy contrast, and paint the eyes red with an outer glow. Apply a glitch, RGB-split and scribble texture over the head, and add a vignette. Use the mosaic floor in the foreground as a pattern.
items.title: Versace: A True Story of Wealth & Murder

items.idea: A FedEx truck is parked on a roulette table, so the company's gamble is shown as the whole fleet sitting on the felt.
items.fusion: The truck is planted on the roulette layout and its wheels touch the numbers and red pocket. Chips and dice orbit it at the corners and tumble around it in the air, so the casino is the truck's road. They are not a separate panel beside it.
layers: blurred red-orange casino glow and a fiery haze with a giant eye or face dissolved into it
green and red roulette felt with numbers along the bottom
large white FedEx truck at a three-quarter angle, its logo side facing right
FedEx boxes stacked at the left edge
tall stack of red chips at the right, soft and out of focus
dark chip and dice pieces in the foreground, blurred and very large
white die and black star chip tumbling in the top corners
glow and heavy contrast grade over everything
items.edges: Every corner is occupied. A die sits top left, a chip top right, boxes at the lower left, chip stacks at the lower right and blurred chips at the bottom centre. The red-orange glow fills the top. The truck's flat white side is the one calm area, and it gives the logo room.
items.background: A hot, blurry casino interior in red and orange with a smoky face or eye shape in the upper right. It is the subject's gamble world, and it makes the white truck stand out as the brightest, cleanest object.
items.lettering: None. The FedEx logo on the trailer and boxes works as the label, in its brand purple and orange.
items.phoneRead: FedEx truck plus casino chips and dice, which reads as FedEx gambling.
items.recipe: Cut out a FedEx truck photo with the logo side visible. Find a roulette table top-down or in perspective, and place the truck on it with a contact shadow. Cut out chip stacks, dice and FedEx boxes, then scale them up and blur the foreground ones for depth. Add a casino photo with heavy blur, red-orange gradient and glow overlays in the upper area. Finish with a saturated grade, a vignette and a bright rim light on the truck.
items.title: Why FedEx Bet Their Entire Company In A Casino

items.idea: Zuckerberg grins in the middle while Google's logo burns in the rubble on his left and Facebook's logo sits on a pile of cash on his right: the winner stands between the ruin and the money.
items.fusion: Real fire is masked onto the top of the Google G so the logo itself is what burns, and it rests on broken rock chunks as if it had fallen. The Facebook 'f' tile is stacked into the cash piles, with bills overlapping its edges and sitting in front of it. Zuckerberg's cut-out overlaps both logos, so he links them into one scene.
layers: Split background: purple ruined skyline on the left, green matrix code on the right
Rock rubble in the bottom left corner
3D Google G tilted and burning
Stacks of dollar bills at the bottom right
Glossy blue Facebook tile
Large Zuckerberg cut-out with a bright rim light
items.edges: Rocks fill the bottom left, flames hit the top left corner, and cash stacks run along the right edge and bottom right. The face covers the centre, and the green code fills the top right. Nothing is empty. The only calm area is the smooth skin of the face.
items.background: Two worlds split down the middle. Destruction on the left is a dark purple dystopian city with dust. Wealth on the right is neon-green falling code. The colours match each logo's story: the left is ruined and sickly, the right is rich and digital.
items.lettering: none. The title is carried by the image: the burning logo is the 'destroyed' and the cash-backed logo is the 'winner'.
items.phoneRead: A smiling man, a burning Google logo and Facebook on a pile of money tell you that Facebook beat Google.
items.recipe: Cut Zuckerberg out of a sharp, smiling photo, add a thin light edge and push the contrast and warmth. Get a 3D Google G PNG, mask a real fire clip over the top-left arc with Screen or Add blending, and add a soft orange glow. Place stone chunks at its base. Use a Facebook logo tile with a slight 3D tilt, then place cash-stack cut-outs in front of and behind it. Build the background from a purple city photo with a dark grade on the left and a green matrix-code overlay on the right. Add a vignette.
items.title: How Facebook Destroyed Google

items.idea: The founder of Raising Cane's holds a platter of chicken tenders while he is surrounded by stacks of money, so the food and the cash are shown as the same story.
items.fusion: He is standing in the cash as if it were a pit, and he holds the plate of tenders in the foreground, so the tenders overlap the money. The logo is raised on a sunburst of the brand colours, which radiates from behind the food and him.
layers: brick wall painted with a yellow and black sunburst
large Raising Cane's logo
bundles of cash across the bottom
smiling man in a black polo, cut out on the right
plate of tenders held in the front left, overlapping the logo and cash
subtle glow around the subject
items.edges: The logo fills the top left. The man fills the right. The tenders and plate fill the middle left. Cash fills the bottom and the right. The brick wall rays reach every edge, so there is no empty corner.
items.background: A painted brick wall with a yellow and black sunburst. It echoes the brand colours and points toward the centre where the food and logo are.
items.lettering: There is no extra text. The big red oval Raising Cane's logo, with its scratchy white script, serves as the title and sits at the top, slightly tilted.
items.phoneRead: A happy guy with a plate of chicken fingers, and money all around. It reads as chicken tenders made him rich.
items.recipe: Make the wall from a brick texture, and overlay yellow wedge rays from a central point with Multiply blend. Place the official logo large and slightly rotated. Cut out the man and a plate of tenders, which can be shot separately, and overlap the plate in front of him. Pile cash photos along the bottom and up the right side. Add a soft shadow and slight brightening to the food, and boost the saturation overall.
items.title: How Chicken Tenders Made Him A Millionaire 🍗

items.idea: The Papa John's logo is sitting on a burning pizza with a $100 bill scorched beneath it, so the brand looks like it's engulfed in scandal.
items.fusion: Fire licks up from both sides and wraps the logo's edges. The pizza fills the entire background, and the burnt, torn bill is tucked under the logo's lower edge as if it were smouldering with the rest. Everything is stacked in a single column in the centre.
layers: close-up pepperoni pizza texture
scorched edges and dark vignette
fire on the left and right
$100 bill with Franklin, torn edges
Papa John's logo badge on top
items.edges: The pepperoni pizza goes to every edge and corner. Flames take the left and right edges, and the banknote's edge runs off the bottom. There are no empty areas beyond the white of the logo.
items.background: The brand's own product, a macro pepperoni pizza, tinted red and darkened. It carries the brand colours, so it feels like the brand's world burning.
items.lettering: The logo is the only lettering: bold red condensed caps in a white and green badge with a green PIZZA ribbon. It is large and sits in the upper-middle, with no added text.
items.phoneRead: Papa John's on fire with money underneath: the brand is burning, and it's about money and scandal.
items.recipe: Use a high-res pepperoni pizza photo as the backdrop and darken it with a vignette. Place the official logo as a flat PNG with a soft shadow. Cut out a $100 bill, tear the top edge with a paper-rip mask and burn the edges with a brown-black brush. Overlay real fire footage or stills on Screen mode on both sides, masking them so they don't cover the logo, and add an orange glow where they meet the logo.
items.title: Papa John's: Scandals, Betrayal & Dumpster Diving

items.idea: A worried LEGO minifigure is waist-deep in a burning sea of LEGO bricks, so the toy itself becomes the victim of the dark truth.
items.fusion: The figure is planted inside the brick pile, with flames licking up around his torso and hard hat. The pile, fire and figure share one lighting and one scene. The lettering is built from LEGO studs, so the brand's own material spells the warning.
layers: black LEGO baseplate stud texture
DARK TRUTH lettering made of white studs
brick piles in red, blue, yellow, white and green on both sides
minifigure with red LEGO hard hat, cut out, centered
flames behind and around the torso
foreground fire at the bottom edge and on the brick piles
warm orange glow on the figure's edges
items.edges: The bottom third is packed with bricks and fire from edge to edge. The two top corners are filled with big white stud letters on black. The only breathing room is the dark studded band around the helmet, which isolates the head.
items.background: A black LEGO baseplate with a faint stud grid. It is the toy's own world, and the dark tone makes the fire and primary colours pop.
items.lettering: DARK on the left and TRUTH on the right, in huge white all-caps letters formed from round studs. There is no box or outline. The letters flank the helmet like a frame and sit at the very top, with the figure's head breaking the gap between them.
items.phoneRead: A sad LEGO guy is stuck in burning bricks, with the words DARK TRUTH. It reads as LEGO has a dark secret.
items.recipe: Cut out a clean minifigure render with the LEGO-logo helmet. Pile many brick photos in a mound on both sides and in front of the figure, overlapping them heavily. Tile a baseplate texture for the background. Build the letters by placing white stud dots on a grid, or mask a stud texture inside bold letter shapes. Add real fire footage on Screen or Lighten blend behind the torso, on the pile edges and across the bottom. Add an orange glow on the figure's edges, and boost saturation and contrast.
items.title: The F**ked Up History of LEGO

items.idea: The company's own logo is on a tombstone in the middle of a firestorm, with 'R.I.P' written below it: the channel announces its own death.
items.fusion: The M logo is carved into the tombstone and takes on its fiery colour, so it looks lit by the fire. The tombstone shape echoes the logo's pentagon outline and its scratches pick up the flame colours. The fire is both behind it and reflected in it.
layers: Full-frame real fire footage
Dark pentagonal tombstone with a glowing edge
Scratches and grit texture on the stone
Gold M logo with fire texture inside
'R.I.P' lettering
Floating sparks across the whole frame
items.edges: Fire fills the left and right edges, and the stone covers the middle. Sparks fill the rest. There is no empty area, and the dark stone is the only place that is quiet.
items.background: Pure flames in red, orange and yellow, so the whole frame is the destruction. The colour matches the logo and text.
items.lettering: 'R.I.P' is in a clean, wide gold sans-serif, centred under the logo and engraved on the stone. It is the same colour as the logo, so it reads as one piece with it.
items.phoneRead: A burning tombstone with an M and R.I.P says the channel is dead.
items.recipe: Use a full-frame fire clip and place a dark pentagon with a bevelled, glowing edge on top. Add a scratched metal or stone texture at low opacity. Add the logo in gold and fill it with a fire texture clipped to the shape. Type R.I.P in the same gold. Overlay spark particles and apply an orange colour grade with a vignette.
items.title: How MagnatesMedia Almost Got DELETED

items.idea: A Starbucks cup is shown in front of a huge green siren logo with the word 'TRUTH', as if the cup is going to reveal the hidden truth behind the brand.
items.fusion: The siren is blown up and faded into the background, so the brand is the surface behind the cup. The cup's own logo is the small copy of that large one, and a white burst around the cup separates it from the siren. The coffee-bean texture runs through the siren, so the logo is made of the product.
layers: Green coffee-bean pattern
Giant green siren logo, low contrast
White burst of rays
Starbucks cup with a white outline
Black and red label boxes with the text
Channel logo at the bottom left
items.edges: The siren fills the bottom and left, the label boxes cover the top left, and the cup and burst take the right. Beans cover everything else. The only empty zone is the plain green between the label boxes and the cup.
items.background: Starbucks-green beans overlaid with the oversized siren. It shows the brand's world and keeps the focus on the cup.
items.lettering: 'Starbucks' in black-on-white heavy sans in a black box, with 'TRUTH' in white on red below. Both are large and left-aligned, at the top left. The red box is a warning label that signals something hidden.
items.phoneRead: A Starbucks cup next to the words 'Starbucks TRUTH' says this is about the hidden truth behind Starbucks.
items.recipe: Make a green background with a coffee-bean texture. Place the siren logo large with low opacity and a green tint. Add a white starburst behind a Starbucks cup cut-out with a thick white outline and drop shadow. Add two rectangles, black and red, with heavy white text, and put the channel logo in the bottom left.
items.title: Why did Starbucks REALLY become so popular?

items.idea: A wild-eyed DeLorean boss holds a syringe in front of his gullwing time-machine car and a police cruiser, a one-frame summary of cars, drugs and the law.
items.fusion: The man's face and syringe hand are huge in the foreground, close to the viewer. The DeLorean and police car sit behind him in the same neon haze, joined by the same purple, blue and orange rim light, so they feel like one scene rather than a collage.
layers: purple and magenta neon city haze
police car with flashing lights, left
DeLorean with open gullwing door, centre
chrome DMC logo, top-left
large man cut-out, right, with orange rim light
hand holding syringe, bottom centre
items.edges: The man occupies the right third and bleeds off the right and bottom edges. The cars fill the left and bottom, the logo occupies the top left, and the haze fills the rest. The only breathing space is the purple sky between the logo and the man's head.
items.background: A glowing purple and pink neon cityscape with police-light blue and red, which reads as an 80s night and has the same palette as the subject.
items.lettering: A chrome, bevelled DMC logo in a retro 3D face, sitting top-left. There's no title text.
items.phoneRead: A man with a syringe, a DeLorean and a police car: a crazy 80s car boss mixed up with drugs and the law.
items.recipe: Cut out the man's portrait with the hand and syringe from a stock photo and push contrast and skin texture with a heavy sharpen. Cut out a DeLorean with the door up and a police car, and place them in perspective. Create the backdrop from a blurred neon city plus a purple gradient. Add rim light with orange and cyan edge glows, add a chrome DMC logo, and apply a final colour grade to the whole image.
items.title: The Craziest CEO Ever: War, Drugs & Time Machines

items.idea: A single glowing toxic-green potion bottle with a skull stopper sits alone in a dark dungeon, so snake oil reads as poison being sold.
items.fusion: The poison look is built into the object: the skull is the cork, skull and tentacle shapes float inside the green liquid, and the bottle's glow lights the floor and wall around it, so the product is the threat and nothing sits beside it.
layers: dark cracked stone wall
stone-slab floor in perspective
green smoke cloud on the wall behind the bottle
green glow pooled on the floor
bottle with liquid and skull pattern inside
skull cork with magenta glowing eyes
white sparkle glints on the glass edges
items.edges: Not dense. The frame is mostly dark stone and the bottle takes the centre. Texture on the wall and floor fills the edges, and the corners fall to near-black as a vignette. The breathing room is deliberate and keeps the bottle isolated.
items.background: The subject's own world: a dungeon wall of concrete panels and a slab floor. A green smoke wisp on the wall echoes the bottle's colour, and the rest is desaturated grey-black so only green and the magenta eyes stand out.
items.lettering: none
items.phoneRead: A glowing skull bottle of poison. The viewer understands 'fake toxic medicine' before reading the title.
items.recipe: Cut out a stylised or 3D potion bottle with a skull cork on a transparent background. Mask a skull and tentacle pattern inside the liquid at low opacity. Use a dark stone wall and a floor-slab photo with perspective. Add real green smoke footage on Screen blend behind the bottle. Add a soft green outer glow and a green colour-dodge pool on the floor under it. Add magenta glow on the eye sockets and sparkle stars on the highlights. Grade the shadows to black and add a vignette.
items.title: The Profitable Business of Selling Snake Oil

items.idea: Coca-Cola's red is flooding over an Arctic ice floe, where the iconic polar bear stands alone, and that suggests the brand's cost to the planet.
items.fusion: The red bleeds from the can side into the ice. Cans are scattered through the red water and snow, and red splotches mark the ice. The bear stands in that red, and the can is cooled on real ice cubes that look like part of the same cold scene.
layers: red ocean and red-tinted sky
white ice floe on the left, with cracks
semi-transparent can pattern fading into the red
polar bear with red scarf, with a long shadow
large Coca-Cola can on ice cubes, with a splash coming from the top
black and red label boxes with white text
small channel logo badge at the bottom left
items.edges: The red fills the right and top edges. The ice fills the left and bottom. The can fills the right side from top to bottom. The label boxes fill the top left. The small bear on empty ice is where the frame breathes.
items.background: Red water and white ice. The red is the brand colour, and the contrast with white ice makes the bear and can stand out.
items.lettering: 'The Dark Truth' in white bold sans serif on a black box, and 'of Coca-Cola' with the official script logo on a red box. The two boxes are stacked on the top left, with the logo in the brand's own typeface and colour.
items.phoneRead: A can of Coke, a lonely bear in a red-stained Arctic, and the words Dark Truth of Coca-Cola. It reads as Coke harms nature.
items.recipe: Use an aerial ice-floe photo and a bear cut-out with a scarf. Tint the water red with a colour layer or gradient map, and paint red splotches on the ice. Tile a faint can pattern with soft masks that fade into the red. Cut out a hi-res can with condensation and place it on an ice-cube photo, with a splash cut-out at the opening. Build the two label boxes with the official logo, and add a long cast shadow under the bear.
items.title: The Genius of Coca-Cola's Marketing
